Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly swapped the release dates in its analysis. It stated that "Ekam – Son Of Soil: release date 2006-09-24" and "Farber's Nerve: release date 2010-04-23". This is the exact opposite of the data retrieved by the WebSurfer in the previous step (which correctly identified Ekam as 2010-04-23 and Farber's Nerve as 2006-09-24). Due to this data inversion, the Planner concluded that Ekam was released first, when in reality, Farber's Nerve (2006) was released before Ekam (2010).
